# CANDIDATE: CANDLE_WICK_REJECTION_AT_NAMED_LEVEL_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A long lower wick rejecting a named support/resistance level (prior day high/low, VWAP, or overnight high/low) with a bullish close indicates buying pressure and a likely bounce. The setup captures mean‑reverting intraday moves when the price tests a significant level and is rejected by strong lower‑shadow buying, especially during mid‑morning when institutional participation aligns with the level.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** When price touches a named level (prior day high, prior day low, VWAP, overnight high, overnight low) within 0.05% AND the bar forms a lower wick ≥ 2× the body length (wick/body ratio ≥2) AND the close is above the midpoint of the bar (bullish close) AND volume > 1.2× the 20‑bar average volume.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the low of the wick (chart‑stop). Target at 1× risk‑reward (i.e., exit at entry + (entry‑wick low)). After 1R is achieved, a runner trails using a 10‑period ATR×2 chandelier exit. Only trades taken between 10:00‑14:00 EST when VIX is between 12‑22; avoid first/last 30 min of session.
